status: Published/source-native settings recorded, no training budget or cohort adopted

NCNC.source_native_training: Per-epoch PyG negative_sampling from the observed bidirectional TRAIN graph; each used positive indexes one generated negative. Mask the current loss-positive batch from message passing. Sum positive/negative log-sigmoid losses, Adam with separate encoder/predictor lr=.001 and weight_decay=0. No gradient clipping in the preserved source. PermIterator uses floor(Ntrain/1024) batches, dropping a shuffled final partial batch each epoch; retain this native behavior.
NCNC.source_native_predictor: incn1cn1 maps to IncompleteCN1Predictor; depth1 residual completion uses the same predictor recursively at depth0 under no_grad. Default -1 support limits disable resampling; clamp uses alpha=.3, scale5.3, offset.5, pt.5. Native puregcn encoder has one layer, xdropout.3, input projection to256 and JK scalar parameter. Retain all operator and initialization behavior.

SAGE.source_native_training: DataLoader shuffles all TRAIN positives including the final partial batch. Remove current loss edges from bidirectional TRAIN adjacency, full graph node forward per minibatch. One random integer-pair negative per positive without observed-positive filtering; sigmoid predictor logarithmic loss. Clip encoder and predictor gradients separately at1; Adam lr=.001 and weight_decay=0. Preserve this native difference from NCNC.
SAGE.source_native_model: Two SAGEConv layers with ReLU/dropout.1 before final layer; elementwise endpoint product followed by three-layer256 MLP with ReLU/dropout.1 and sigmoid.

shared_native_budget.actual_stop_condition: kill_cnt > 10, i.e. 11 consecutive validation evaluations without strict improvement
shared_native_budget.selected_epoch: First maximum of rounded validation MRR; no later tie replacement

publication_source_vs_exploration.previous_three_seed_proposal: Not adopted; superseded as a suggested cohort by the source-native default record
publication_source_vs_exploration.resource_qualification_option: Root may choose the author-documented --runs1 --seed0 for one complete NCNC/SAGE pair to qualify runtime and source outputs. This option is not frozen, not a final study and not a mean/std report. Any admitted exploration cohort is fixed separately before observing its outcomes.

environment_sources.inconsistencies: requirements.txt and heart_env.yml disagree on several PyG/scatter/sparse/scipy/sklearn versions; record the actual root-chosen environment and qualify native operators, rather than treating a modern substitution as exact.
